item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"Agencies are directed to coordinate, manage, and conduct biodefense activities under the Strategy; this governs ongoing discretionary executive implementation without itself changing legal rights or requiring a specified later legal outcome.","evidence":"agencies shall coordinate and manage biodefense activities"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"Agency heads and the APNSA must prioritize, coordinate, monitor, and review implementation through internal planning and policy processes; no substantive legal consequence is presently imposed or dictated for later imposition.","evidence":"the heads of agencies shall"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The memorandum immediately establishes and staffs an internal interagency committee and assigns it monitoring and coordination duties, which is executive organization rather than a change in legal rights.","evidence":"There is hereby established a Biodefense Steering Committee"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Committee and its chair receive internal consensus-building, advisory, and coordination responsibilities, with any advisory mechanisms left discretionary.","evidence":"The Secretary, as the Chair of the Committee, shall serve as the Federal lead in coordinating implementation of the Strategy."},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary must establish an internal coordination team within 90 days; establishing and locating an executive-branch body is internal organization.","evidence":"the Secretary shall, within 90 days of the date of this memorandum, establish a Biodefense Coordination Team"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary must select a senior official to direct the internal team, which is a staffing assignment without an external legal consequence.","evidence":"The Secretary shall designate a senior official"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"The director receives an internal reporting line, while named officials must support the team, potentially by detailing personnel; these are internal management measures.","evidence":"shall support the work of the Team"},{"segment_id":"8","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary must arrange appropriate departmental resources for the team's work, an internal resource-management instruction that does not itself release funds or confer an entitlement.","evidence":"shall ensure that appropriate resources are provided"},{"segment_id":"9","code":1,"rationale":"The Team must assist with monitoring, coordination, and situational awareness and may convene working groups, all of which are internal administrative functions.","evidence":"assist the Committee in monitoring and coordinating implementation of the Strategy"},{"segment_id":"10","code":1,"rationale":"The Team must identify possible coordination improvements with outside partners; this is a planning and coordination task without a prescribed legal result.","evidence":"shall identify opportunities to increase coordination"},{"segment_id":"11","code":1,"rationale":"The Team must create internal operating policies subject to approval, and the Secretary must give an establishment notice; both are executive housekeeping actions.","evidence":"establish policies, processes, and procedures to govern its activities"},{"segment_id":"12","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary and Covered Officials must conduct a recurring internal information-request and reporting process concerning agency programs, resources, implementation, and obstacles.","evidence":"Covered Officials shall respond to these requests within 60 days"},{"segment_id":"13","code":1,"rationale":"Agencies and the Team must circulate internal memoranda, while Covered Officials receive a reporting exemption for sensitive operational information; the segment governs internal reporting rather than substantive legal rights.","evidence":"Each agency shall provide its Biodefense Memorandum"},{"segment_id":"14","code":1,"rationale":"The Team must prepare an analytical assessment and recommendations about implementation and resources; the assessment itself does not allocate resources or dictate a legal outcome.","evidence":"shall prepare a Biodefense Assessment"},{"segment_id":"15","code":1,"rationale":"The Team must coordinate, submit, summarize, and publicly report on its assessment according to specified deadlines, which constitutes internal review and reporting.","evidence":"The Team shall coordinate the Assessment with the NSC staff and the OMB"},{"segment_id":"16","code":1,"rationale":"Covered Officials must prepare policy guidance and include specified program and funding information in proposed budgets; these are planning and budget-formulation duties, not present appropriations or mandated funding awards.","evidence":"shall prepare joint policy guidance"},{"segment_id":"17","code":1,"rationale":"Covered Officials must submit an internal memorandum communicating their response to policy guidance, with no independent legal consequence.","evidence":"shall submit a memorandum to the NSC staff and the OMB"},{"segment_id":"18","code":1,"rationale":"Covered Officials must prioritize agency activities within OMB budget guidance, an internal programmatic and budget-management direction.","evidence":"shall ensure that new and existing activities are prioritized"},{"segment_id":"19","code":1,"rationale":"The Team must develop a proposal for performance measures and agency responsibilities for later internal approval; the segment does not itself establish those proposed measures or dictate an external legal outcome.","evidence":"shall develop a proposal for metrics, milestones, end states, and roles and responsibilities of agencies"},{"segment_id":"20","code":1,"rationale":"Covered Officials must periodically review the Strategy and may revise it when appropriate, which is discretionary policy review rather than a dictated legal result.","evidence":"shall review and, as appropriate, revise the Strategy"},{"segment_id":"21","code":1,"rationale":"The APNSA must coordinate and submit Strategy updates, may release them subject to law and policy, and may reassign the Committee chair with unanimous approval; these are internal coordination and authority-assignment functions.","evidence":"may designate a different member of the Committee to serve as Chair"},{"segment_id":"22","code":1,"rationale":"The segment immediately supersedes earlier presidential policy directives and preserves existing statutory and OMB functions; under the codebook, revoking or replacing prior directives that organize administration is internal management.","evidence":"are hereby superseded and replaced"}]}
